bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
W="$P/.worktrees/recruit-tumblr-merged-20261114"
test -f "$W/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" || exit 50
CURRENT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')
OLD=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$CURRENT" = "$OLD" || { echo ROLLBACK_IMAGE_NOT_MATCHED; exit 51; }
LIVE=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test -n "$LIVE" || exit 52
test "$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$OLD" || exit 53
test "$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 54
test -f "$P/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" || exit 55
test -f "$P/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" || exit 56
test ! -f "$W/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" || exit 57
docker compose --project-directory "$P/deploy" -p deploy -f "$W/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config -q || exit 58
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 59
echo ROLLBACK_AND_SECRET_DIRECTORY_CAUSE_VERIFIED
echo CORRECTION_USE_ORIGINAL_DEPLOY_PROJECT_DIR
